headline: Growth accelerates, margin pressure persists
summary_short: Net profit rose to Rp4.15 trillion (+11.08% y/y) as total assets grew 15.96% y/y to Rp464 trillion and deposits (DPK) climbed 21.81% y/y to Rp393.34 trillion, while net interest margin contracted 31bps y/y to roughly 5.4%.
summary_long: Net profit reached Rp4.15 trillion, up 11.08% y/y, on 15.96% y/y asset growth to Rp464 trillion. Financing expanded 15.98% y/y to Rp340 trillion; deposits (DPK) rose 21.81% y/y to Rp393.34 trillion, with cost of fund down 49bps to 2.19%. Net interest margin narrowed 31bps y/y to roughly 5.4%. NPF gross held at 1.8%; NPF net 0.33%. EPS registered IDR42.4, down 10.98% q/q from IDR47.63 prior quarter.
